cards.heading: The habit loop
cards.body: Every habit has three parts: cue → routine → reward. Cannabis became your routine for a cue (stress, boredom) to get a reward (relaxation). You need a new routine — not no routine.

cards.heading: Stack, don't replace
cards.body: The easiest way to build a new habit is to attach it to something you already do. After dinner (existing habit) → take a 10-minute walk (new habit).

cards.heading: Start small
cards.body: Tiny habits build identity. You're not 'trying to exercise' — you're 'someone who moves every day'. Start with 2 minutes.

cards.prompt: What is one small habit you could add to your day that gives you a feeling similar to what you used to get from cannabis — relaxation, creativity, or social connection?
